notes: Piloting a UFO over a landscape on a repeatable pickup loop is vehicle operation, so this is Simulation rather than Infinite Runner: the player steers their own flight over a compact map instead of being auto-run down a lane, which is the boundary the genre notes draw. Shape is volume-open-air because the play space really is the air, with the fields below as the surfaces the UFO drops to; I kept the Aircraft Operation preset's shape but replaced its option set, dropping social-hub and gate-progression since an endless-score game has nothing to buy and no progression walls. The cows are collectible-nodes bent to grazing livestock in the fields, and the airplanes are hazard-kill as dynamic traffic crossing the flight space. With no user to ask I took the stated endless score to mean there is no finish or reward zone, and I flagged CHECK rather than treating it as blocking: a few fields with a flight ceiling is a play-height envelope over one representable surface, so the volume should not self-occlude.
